entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-21
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Exception in CSharpInlineMethodRefactoringProvider #81406
  • Completion should include C# 14 extension property in object initializers #81405
  • Assertion when trying to rename a type to "extension" via refactoring #81402
  • "Introduce parameter" may generate duplicate/ambiguous parameters #81400
  • Proposal: Two-Phase Incremental Generators for Cross-Generator Dependencies #81395

Closed

  • C# 14 extension members: generic inference fails where classic extension methods succeed #81356
    18.3
  • Exception when trying to rename a file whose type is named like a reserved Windows file name #81403
  • Syntax error in if() in catch in lambda completely breaks brace matching #4009
    Backlog
  • Error recovery doesn't recover at end of method with error, leading to incorrect completion list #16595
    Backlog
  • Problem using latest Microsoft.Build.Locator #81398
  • Internal extension property + InternalsVisibleTo triggers CS0570 (not supported by the language) in consumer assembly #81180
    18.3
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-11221.11 #81397
  • False positive CS8620 with extension+params #81396
  • Incorrect extension block params nullability warning in .NET 10 #81394
  • Dropdowns in Code Style options have varying heights in other languages #71630
    18.3
  • csharp_prefer_brace not working with 17.9 #72488
    18.3
  • Namespace Rename Feature Does Not Allow Dots #81391
  • Do not restore loose files which lack file-based app directives #81252
    18.3

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix some minor UI errors that were caused by binding failures #81407
    Area-IDE, Community, Needs UX Triage
  • Fix duplicate parameter names in introduce parameter refactoring #81404
    VSCode
  • Merge 'main' into features/collection-expression-arguments #81392
    Needs UX Triage, Needs API Review, VSCode
  • Remove non-cohost bits from C# extension #81390
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Do not report parse errors for '#:' in miscellaneous files #81385
    Area-Compilers, VSCode, Feature - Run File

Merged

  • Fix typing of 'else' causing unwanted indentation of following statement #81393
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Improve error recovery in parenthesized constructs #81279
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • 17.12 ComponentGovernance update for MessagePack package #81384
  • Extensions: Compare accessibility of implementation method with accessibility of declared extension method #81378
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything, Next
  • Fix comparer in StringTokenMap #81341
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #81389
    Area-Infrastructure, Next
  • Show semantic errors for loose files with top-level statements #81326
    Area-Infrastructure, VSCode, Next

Updated

  • Refactoring Integration Test stage into a template #81383
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Improve diagnostic for != operator in patterns #81294
    Area-Compilers, VSCode
  • Improve compiler error recovery for null coalesce assignment operator #80907
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Do not copy hoisted locals or parameters unnecessarily #81227
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Runtime Async
  • Register encoding provider when `GetEncoding` throws `NotSupportedException` #81382
    Area-Compilers
  • Reduce cascading errors when record inherits from non-record #81293
    Area-Compilers, VSCode
  • Report ERR_PatternWrongType for Union matching scenarios #81352
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unions
  • Unsafe evolution: require unsafe for some pointer operations #81240
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Improve error message for misplaced variable designator in property patterns #81287
    Area-Compilers
  • EnC: Block additions to MethodImpl table when targeting .NET Framework #81304
